name: modules/design
description: The EDGE component vocabulary and the theme tokens every surface renders through.

floors.mutation-is-zero-because: Five enums and a resolver; `Typeface` has cases and no methods. `ThemeToken::in()` and `safeAsText()`, `Radius::points()` and `TypeSize::points()` are read arm by arm: `ThemeTokenTest` and `ThemeTest` here, `BrandPaletteParityTest` and `BrandMeasuresParityTest` against the brand's own token file, and `TheAccentIsTheBrandsTest` and `TheThemeIsRegisteredAtBootTest` through the booted application. A mutant in a table arm is a value spelled differently, and those refuse one by name.
